title: A Phase 2 Study on the Safety and Efficacy of the Anti-BAFF-R Monoclonal Antibody, ESG206, in Patients With Primary Sjogren Syndrome
off: A Phase 2 Study on the Safety and Efficacy of the Anti-BAFF-R Monoclonal Antibody, ESG206, in Patients With Primary Sjogren Syndrome
summary: This is a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase II study designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ESG206 in participants with primary Sjögren's syndrome.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults (≥18 years of age) with a confirmed diagnosis of primary Sjögren's syndrome according to the 2016 American College of Rheumatology (ACR) / European League Against Rheumatism (EULAR) classification criteria.
* Evidence of active disease at screening
* Willing and able to provide written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Secondary Sjögren's syndrome or other clinically significant autoimmune or inflammatory diseases
* Prior or recent use of prohibited immunomodulatory therapies
* Clinically significant infections, malignancies, or uncontrolled medical conditions
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding

arms.d: ESG206 Low Dose Injection administered by intravenous infusion
ESG206 High Dose Injection administered by intravenous infusion
Placebo Injection administered by intravenous infusion

primary.m: Change from baseline in ESSDAI score compared with placebo.
